verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes an official MCP server letting agents interact with the Stripe API directly (stripe-billing-docs-18, stripe-billing-probe-4), and the underlying data needed—subscription status via webhooks, invoices, recovery/delinquency analytics, and subscription analytics/benchmarks—are all documented API/dashboard capabilities (stripe-billing-docs-8, -11, -23, -25, -30). However, there's no evidence of a concrete 'MRR' metric endpoint or a documented example of an agent actually querying these specific billing states end-to-end. Missing for 10: a worked example or docs showing an agent retrieving MRR/delinquent-account lists via the MCP server, and independent hands-on confirmation that the MCP tools expose these specific queries rather than just generic API access.
